data.context: In the 2024 report *Raising the Bar reforms: Measuring the impact on relative patent scope*, the Introduction describes a two-stage study of Australian patent claim scope compared with equivalent EPO and USPTO patents. It explains the manual review of 500 patent triplets and the machine-learning analysis of more than 80,000 triplets with examination request years from 2000 to 2019, used to assess the impact of Australia’s 2013 Raising the Bar reforms.
